about: Engine features EngineWire.Build.cs detects from the engine's own files, never from a version number. A row is present when the first of its paths that exists (file or folder, relative to the Engine folder) holds its marker text, or exists at all when it has no marker. A row with "define": true becomes MCP_HAS_<name> (1 or 0) for the C++, in place of an engine-version test.

features.name: PCG_API
features.why: the PCG helpers, node settings and subgraph calls the PCG handlers use

features.name: PCG_EXPORTS_DATA
features.why: a PCG header reads exported data, so PCG cannot be delay-loaded (LNK1194)

features.name: MRQ_JOB_ENABLE
features.why: the Movie Render Queue job API the render handlers need

features.name: SUBOBJECT_DATA_INTERFACE
features.why: else the module is SubobjectData

features.name: GEOMETRY_SCRIPT_COLLISION
features.why: simple and convex collision from a dynamic mesh (configure_mesh_collision)

features.name: IK_RETARGET_DEFAULT_OPS
features.why: a retargeter's chains live on its op stack, which a new one gets from AddDefaultOps

features.name: IK_RETARGET_CHAIN_BY_NAME
features.why: Get/SetSourceChain by chain name and AutoMapChains(type, force)

features.name: IK_RETARGET_RIG_BY_SIDE
features.why: the controller returns the source or target IK Rig

features.name: LANDSCAPE_EDIT_LAYER_CLASSES
features.why: edit layers have classes (ULandscapeEditLayerSplines), made by CreateLayer(name, class)

features.name: LANDSCAPE_FIND_LAYER_CONST
features.why: a landscape finds its edit layer of a class (FindLayerOfType before it)

features.name: LANDSCAPE_EDIT_LAYERS_ONLY
features.why: every landscape has edit layers; HasLayersContent is deprecated

features.name: LANDSCAPE_EDIT_LAYER_NAME
features.why: a layer's name comes from its edit layer object

features.name: TRACE_CONNECTION_QUERY
features.why: FTraceAuxiliary's exported connection queries (IsConnected, GUIDs, destination, channels)

features.name: TRACE_SYSTEM_STATUS
features.why: the trace system's status (not available, tracing to server or file)

features.name: TRACE_CUSTOM_RELAY
features.why: tracing to a custom relay (EConnectionType::Relay is there by then)

features.name: TRACE_SECURE_NETWORK
features.why: tracing to a secure network connection

features.name: ANIM_DATA_FRAME_COUNT
features.why: an animation's length in frames (SetNumberOfFrames), bone curves (AddBoneCurve) and IAnimationDataModel::IsValidBoneTrackName

features.name: BLACKBOARD_KEY_DEFAULTS
features.why: blackboard keys (bool, int, float, string, name, vector, rotator) carry default values

features.name: BLACKBOARD_ENUM_DEFAULT
features.why: an enum blackboard key carries a default value

features.name: STATE_TREE_EDITING_SUBSYSTEM
features.why: a State Tree compiles through UStateTreeEditingSubsystem (the editor module's compile request before)

features.name: STATE_TREE_LOG_TEXT_MESSAGE
features.why: a State Tree compiler message is FText (FString before)

buildQuirks.name: MSVC_HAS_FEATURE_WORKAROUND
buildQuirks.why: UE 5.0-5.2 headers evaluate __has_feature under current MSVC; ApplyMsvcCompatibility keeps its version test, the one named exception
